verdict.rationale: Role-based access control is a fair question for a work-management tool like Trello, but the evidence pack never documents board, workspace or card roles, or any view/edit permission levels. The only permission-related item is API token scope configuration for developer authorization. That is an adjacent developer feature, not user role management, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can assign granular permissions and roles to control who can view or edit work
